license_required.quote: a person shall not serve as an attendant on any ambulance or air ambulance and a firefighter shall not provide the level of medical care provided by an advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic to sick or injured persons at the scene of an emergency or while transporting those persons to a medical facility unless the person holds a currently valid license issued by the health authority under the provisions of this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Health Authority (Division of Public and Behavioral Health or district board of health)
issuing_authority.quote: The health authority may issue licenses to attendants and to firefighters employed by or serving as volunteers with a fire-fighting agency.

name.value: Health Authority (Division of Public and Behavioral Health or district board of health depending on county population)
name.quote: "Health authority" means: 1. In a county whose population is less than 700,000, the Division. 2. In a county whose population is 700,000 or more, the district board of health.

type.quote: "Division" means the Division of Public and Behavioral Health of the Department of Health and Human Services.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Health and Human Services
umbrella_agency.quote: "Division" means the Division of Public and Behavioral Health of the Department of Health and Human Services.

degree_required.value: Successful completion of an approved program of training as an emergency medical technician
degree_required.quote: A current, valid certificate evidencing the applicant's successful completion of a program of training as an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic, if the applicant is applying for a license as an attendant

accrediting_body.value: Program supervised by a physician and approved by the health authority, or presented by a nationally recognized organization and approved by the board
accrediting_body.quote: A program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician must be: (a) Supervised by a physician and approved by the health authority; or (b) Presented by a national organization which is nationally recognized for providing such training and approved by the board.

degree_level.quote: A program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician must follow the curriculum or educational standards prepared by the United States Department of Transportation as a national standard for emergency medical technicians.

school_approval_basis.quote: Supervised by a physician and approved by the health authority; or (b) Presented by a national organization which is nationally recognized for providing such training and approved by the board.

credential_pegged.quote: A program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician must follow the curriculum or educational standards prepared by the United States Department of Transportation as a national standard for emergency medical technicians.

required.quote: A program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician must be: (a) Supervised by a physician and approved by the health authority; or (b) Presented by a national organization which is nationally recognized for providing such training and approved by the board.

experience_source.quote: A program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician must follow the curriculum or educational standards prepared by the United States Department of Transportation as a national standard for emergency medical technicians.

exams.name: National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) examination
exams.notes: Required as a condition of home state licensure for participation in the REPLICA interstate compact at the EMT and paramedic levels.
exams.quote: Currently requires the use of the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) examination as a condition of issuing initial licenses at the EMT and paramedic levels

interval_years.quote: A certificate is valid for a period not exceeding 2 years and may be renewed if the holder of the certificate complies with the provisions of this chapter and meets the qualifications set forth in the regulations and standards established by the board pursuant to this chapter.

required.quote: In order to maintain certification, each advanced emergency medical technician must annually: (a) Comply with the requirements established by the board for continuing medical education

period_years.quote: In order to maintain certification, each advanced emergency medical technician must annually: (a) Comply with the requirements established by the board for continuing medical education

value: Course relating to medical consequences of an act of terrorism involving a weapon of mass destruction (at least 4 hours, within 2 years after initial certification)
Training concerning identifying and interacting with persons with developmental disabilities
topical_requirements.quote: The regulations and standards established by the board must provide for the completion of: (a) A course of instruction, within 2 years after initial certification, relating to the medical consequences of an act of terrorism that involves the use of a weapon of mass destruction. The course must provide at least 4 hours of instruction

available.quote: The Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact is hereby ratified and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining the Compact

requirements.value: Nevada has enacted the REPLICA interstate compact. A home state license authorizes practice in remote states if the home state requires NREMT exam, has complaint mechanisms, reports adverse actions, requires criminal background checks, and complies with Commission rules. Member states must recognize the privilege to practice of individuals licensed in another member state in conformance with Section 3.
requirements.quote: Any member state in which an individual holds a current license shall be deemed a home state for purposes of this Compact.

exists.quote: The Committee on Emergency Medical Services, consisting of 11 members appointed by the State Board of Health, is hereby created.

name.quote: "Committee" means the Committee on Emergency Medical Services.

authority.value: The Committee reviews and advises the Division regarding management and performance of emergency medical services, advises on policy matters, advises the board and Division with respect to preparation and adoption of regulations, reviews the Division budget related to EMS, and encourages training and education of EMS personnel.
authority.quote: The Committee shall: 1. Review and advise the Division regarding the management and performance of emergency medical services in this State and regarding statewide emergency medical protocols; 2. Advise the Division on matters of policy relating to emergency care, including, without limitation, the qualifications of persons who provide emergency medical services; 3. Advise the board and Division with respect to the preparation and adoption of regulations regarding emergency care

national_certification.value: National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT)
national_certification.quote: Currently requires the use of the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) examination as a condition of issuing initial licenses at the EMT and paramedic levels

credential_type.quote: The health authority may issue licenses to attendants and to firefighters employed by or serving as volunteers with a fire-fighting agency.

is_mandatory.quote: a person shall not serve as an attendant on any ambulance or air ambulance and a firefighter shall not provide the level of medical care provided by an advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic to sick or injured persons at the scene of an emergency or while transporting those persons to a medical facility unless the person holds a currently valid license issued by the health authority under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: A person shall not represent himself or herself to be an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic unless the person has been issued a currently valid certificate by the health authority or is practicing under the Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact ratified by NRS 450B.145.

scope_protection.quote: a person shall not serve as an attendant on any ambulance or air ambulance and a firefighter shall not provide the level of medical care provided by an advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic to sick or injured persons at the scene of an emergency or while transporting those persons to a medical facility unless the person holds a currently valid license issued by the health authority under the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Certificate or license may be suspended or revoked if the holder no longer meets the prescribed qualifications.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The health authority may suspend or revoke a certificate if it finds that the holder of the certificate no longer meets the prescribed qualifications.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permit may be revoked, suspended or not renewed for violation of any provision of the chapter or regulations.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revoke, suspend or refuse to renew any permit issued pursuant to this section for violation of any provision of this chapter or of any regulation adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: License or certificate may not be issued or renewed if applicant fails to attest to knowledge of and compliance with CDC guidelines on safe injection practices.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The health authority shall not issue or renew: 1. A license to an attendant or firefighter; or 2. A certificate, unless the applicant for issuance or renewal of the license or certificate attests to knowledge of and compliance with the guidelines of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention concerning the prevention of transmission of infectious agents through safe and appropriate injection practices.

disciplinary_grounds.description: License or certificate may not be issued or renewed if applicant is subject to a child support court order and is not in compliance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A license or certificate described in subsection 1 may not be issued or renewed by the health authority if the applicant: (a) Fails to submit the statement required pursuant to subsection 1; or (b) Indicates on the statement submitted pursuant to subsection 1 that the applicant is subject to a court order for the support of a child and is not in compliance with the order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any person who violates any provision of the chapter is guilty of a misdemeanor and subject to administrative penalty.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any person who violates any of the provisions of this chapter is guilty of a misdemeanor.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unlawful for a person who administers emergency medical services to fail willfully to transfer a qualified patient in accordance with do-not-resuscitate protocol provisions.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: It is unlawful for: (a) A person who administers emergency medical services to fail willfully to transfer a qualified patient in accordance with the provisions of NRS 450B.550.

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A person or governmental entity shall not engage in the operation of any ambulance or air ambulance service in this state without a currently valid permit for that service issued by the health authority.

definition_quote.value: Emergency medical technician means a person who is: 1. Certified by the health officer as having satisfactorily completed a program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician pursuant to NRS 450B.1905; or 2. Practicing as an emergency medical technician in this State under the Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact ratified by NRS 450B.145.
definition_quote.quote: "Emergency medical technician" means a person who is: 1. Certified by the health officer as having satisfactorily completed a program of training for certification as an emergency medical technician pursuant to NRS 450B.1905; or 2. Practicing as an emergency medical technician in this State under the Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact ratified by NRS 450B.145.

value: Emergency medical care at the scene of an emergency
Transportation of sick or injured persons
Advanced life support procedures (paramedics and AEMTs)
Administration of drugs and procedures approved by regulation of the board
Immunizations, dispensing medication, and public health response (with endorsement)
methods_authorized.quote: the board shall determine the procedures and techniques which may be performed by an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic.

drug_authority.value: An advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic may perform any procedure and administer any drug approved by regulation of the board, or authorized pursuant to NRS 450B.1975 with endorsement.
drug_authority.quote: An advanced emergency medical technician may perform any procedure and administer any drug: 1. Approved by regulation of the board; or 2. Authorized pursuant to NRS 450B.1975, if the advanced emergency medical technician has obtained an endorsement pursuant to that section.

certification_levels.quote: Any person desiring certification as an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic must apply to the health authority using forms prescribed by the health authority.

national_registry_exam_required.quote: Currently requires the use of the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT) examination as a condition of issuing initial licenses at the EMT and paramedic levels

value: Endorsement to administer immunizations, dispense medication and respond to public health needs
Endorsement to provide community paramedicine services
advanced_practice_subspecialties.quote: An advanced emergency medical technician or a paramedic who holds an endorsement to administer immunizations, dispense medication and prepare and respond to certain public health needs issued in accordance with the regulations adopted pursuant to this section may: (a) Administer immunizations and dispense medications

community_paramedicine_authorized.quote: "Community paramedicine services" means services provided by an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic to patients who do not require emergency medical transportation and provided in a manner that is integrated with the health care and social services resources available in the community.

medical_director_required.quote: Practice under the supervision of a medical director.

protocol_approval_process.value: The board (State Board of Health for counties under 700,000 population; district board of health for counties 700,000 or more) adopts regulations and standards; the Committee on Emergency Medical Services advises regarding statewide emergency medical protocols.
protocol_approval_process.quote: Review and advise the Division regarding the management and performance of emergency medical services in this State and regarding statewide emergency medical protocols

ambulance_service_license_required.quote: A person or governmental entity shall not engage in the operation of any ambulance or air ambulance service in this state without a currently valid permit for that service issued by the health authority.

ambulance_vehicle_inspection_required.quote: the health authority shall cause to be inspected the ambulances, aircraft, vehicles, medical supplies, equipment, personnel, records, premises and operational procedures of a holder of a permit whenever that inspection is deemed necessary, but no less frequently than once each year.

minimum_staffing_requirements.value: An ambulance carrying a sick or injured patient must be occupied by a driver and an attendant, each of whom is licensed as an attendant pursuant to this chapter (or exempt/authorized under REPLICA). Geographic exceptions may be designated by the board.
minimum_staffing_requirements.quote: An ambulance carrying a sick or injured patient must be occupied by a driver and an attendant, each of whom is licensed as an attendant pursuant to this chapter, exempt from licensing pursuant to subsection 7 of NRS 450B.160 or authorized to practice in this State under the Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact ratified by NRS 450B.145, except as otherwise provided in subsection 5 or in geographic areas which may be designated by the board and for which the board may prescribe lesser qualifications.

rural_county_staffing_exception.quote: except as otherwise provided in subsection 5 or in geographic areas which may be designated by the board and for which the board may prescribe lesser qualifications.

regional_ems_council_structure.quote: The Committee on Emergency Medical Services, consisting of 11 members appointed by the State Board of Health, is hereby created.

trauma_system_designation.quote: The board shall establish a program for treating persons who require treatment for trauma and for transporting and admitting such persons to centers for the treatment of trauma.

interstate_compact_member.quote: The Recognition of Emergency Medical Services Personnel Licensure Interstate Compact is hereby ratified and entered into with all other jurisdictions legally joining the Compact

military_veteran_licensure_pathway.quote: Member states shall consider a veteran, active military service member and member of the National Guard and Reserves separating from an active duty tour, and a spouse thereof, who holds a current valid and unrestricted NREMT certification at or above the level of the state license being sought as satisfying the minimum training and examination requirements for such licensure.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: An applicant for any permit, license or certificate issued pursuant to this chapter shall furnish to the health authority a complete set of the applicant's fingerprints and written permission authorizing the health authority to forward those fingerprints to the Central Repository for Nevada Records of Criminal History for submission to the Federal Bureau of Investigation for its report.

value: EMT: procedures and techniques determined by the board; curriculum at level of advanced first aid or at least equivalent to DOT national standard
AEMT: approved curriculum in intravenous therapy and management of airway passage; any procedure and drug approved by regulation of the board or authorized via endorsement
Paramedic: any procedure and drug approved by regulation of the board or authorized via endorsement; highest scope of practice
scope_of_practice_by_level.quote: The board shall determine the procedures and techniques which may be performed by an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic.

epinephrine_administration_authorized.quote: auto-injectable epinephrine maintained by an authorized entity pursuant to this section may be provided to a person for self-administration or may be administered to any person reasonably believed to be experiencing anaphylaxis by... a provider of emergency medical services

aed_program_regulated.quote: The Division shall: (a) Within the limitations of available funding, establish and maintain a database containing: (1) The name and address of each person who owns an automated external defibrillator for commercial use in this State

ems_data_collection_required.quote: Each holder of a permit shall maintain accurate records upon such forms as may be provided by the health authority and containing such information as may be reasonably required by the board concerning the care or transportation of each patient, or both, within this state and beyond its limits.

emergency_medical_dispatcher_certificati.quote: "Emergency medical dispatcher" means a person who: 1. Has completed a training program in emergency medical dispatching which has been approved by the board; and 2. Has been certified as having satisfactorily completed such a training program by an entity approved by the board to provide such training.

civil_immunity_for_good_faith_care.quote: A person is not guilty of unprofessional conduct or subject to civil or criminal liability if the person... (c) Administers emergency medical services and: (1) Causes or participates in the withholding of life-resuscitating treatment from a qualified patient who possesses a do-not-resuscitate identification
